# RtsUpx.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

Realtek RtsUpx.sys 1.13.0.0 is within the affected range through 1.14.0.0. CVE-2021-36925 permits unauthorized physical-memory read/write through crafted device requests. Related vulnerabilities affect USB device access (CVE-2021-36922), privileged IN/OUT instructions (CVE-2021-36923), and pool memory handling (CVE-2021-36924). Static inspection of this sample confirms caller-controlled physical-memory mapping and copying in the device-control handler.
- **UUID**: d1110c3d-3c4c-498e-b9ad-b8874b25841f
- **Created**: 2026-10-17
- **Author**: Element2023H
- **Acknowledgement**: Element2023H | [@Element2023H](https://twitter.com/@Element2023H)

{{< blockbanner "RtsUpx.sys" >}}
### Commands

```
sc.exe create RtsUpx binPath= C:\windows\temp\RtsUpx.sys type= kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start RtsUpx
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Allows local low-privileged users to achieve an arbitrary read or write operation from/to physical memory. | Unprivileged user with access to the loaded driver device; administrator rights to load it. | Windows |
